experience.title: Front-end in practice
experience.intro: In industrial dashboards and admin panel projects I built all front-end components and the functions that map statuses (equipment, sessions, motors, lubrication, etc.). Each area below represents end-to-end work I implemented.
experience.subtitle: Dashboards, admin panels, and this portfolio.

auth.title: Authentication and protected routes
auth.description: JWT login, route-level auth wrapper, 401 redirect, and password recovery.
auth.highlight: Login, register and password recovery components; reusable auth middleware.

state.title: Global state and persistence
state.description: Zustand with persist to localStorage; getters/setters for use outside React (e.g. API layer).
state.highlight: Stores for session, preferences and layout; integration with request layer.

i18n.title: Internationalization (i18n)
i18n.description: react-i18next with pt-BR and en-US; locale synced with theme and date formatting (dayjs).
i18n.highlight: Namespaced translations; Ant Design and dayjs locale sync.

realtime.title: Real-time communication
realtime.description: WebSocket/Socket.io for live dashboards and chat; typing indicators and online status.
realtime.highlight: Per-equipment events; status indicators and real-time controls.

api.title: Centralized API layer
api.description: Single client with env-based base URLs, token injection, and 401 handling (logout/redirect).
api.highlight: Typed request plugin per API; error handling and i18n toasts.

theming.title: Theming and design system
theming.description: Styled-components with semantic theme; dark/light mode; no inline styles; reusable components.
theming.highlight: All UI components in .style.ts; semantic tokens and customized Ant Design.

dashboards.title: Dashboards and data visualization
dashboards.description: Charts (e.g. amCharts), maps, and panels with real-time equipment data.
dashboards.highlight: Status mapping functions per equipment; Crusher, Patriot, VSI modules; charts and maps.

crud.title: Admin and CRUD
crud.description: Lists, tables, drawers and modals for Create/Read/Update/Delete; filters and breadcrumbs.
crud.highlight: Reusable drawers and modals; tables with column state; status functions for listings.

architecture.title: Component architecture
architecture.description: Structure .tsx + .style.ts + .types.ts; import sections; strict typing with TypeScript.
architecture.highlight: Hundreds of custom components; enums for status and roles; code conventions.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Jest and React Testing Library for unit tests; Playwright for E2E; Storybook for component docs.
testing.highlight: Component and flow tests; stories per component; E2E for critical flows.
